title: The systemic trip begins
hook: Trace one part of the circulation.

knows: The heart has atria and ventricles.
doesNotKnow: The left ventricle pumps blood through the aorta into systemic circulation, supplying body tissues.

misconception: Blood passes randomly between the four chambers.
objective: Trace the specified step in normal mammalian circulation.

claims.text: Question, diagram and reveal: The left ventricle pumps blood through the aorta toward which destination? The left ventricle pumps blood through the aorta into systemic circulation, supplying body tissues. The diagram is a simplified flow map, not the shape or scale of the heart and vessels.
